target: UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, AArch64 PCI graphical guest, one vCPU, isolated disposable guest disk
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-tos-distro-std-current-c161-2026-11-12.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-tos-distro-std
result: partial: standard distro source packaging completes; BIOS-only boot image generation stops at the intentional ARM64 ArmBoot guard
verified: The exact current ISO booted to the graphical terminal under UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF.
MakeHome and MakeTOS loaded, TOS_HDS selected CD source mode, and TOSStdDistroBuild prepared the full source tree on the isolated disposable guest disk.
At BootDVDIns, the guest raised uncaught exception 0x00746f6f426d7241 (ASCII ArmBoot); this is the existing guard against legacy BIOS boot-image generation without an ARM64 EFI path.
